Separate aligned Arizona classifications avoid misusing the Pennsylvania apparel field; married-debtor limits are combined as Arizona law permits.

blocks.rationale: Create a narrowly scoped terminal helper for the §152(b)(1) trigger. The operative fact is whether the current claim subject is another taxpayer's dependent; if so, the statute treats that individual as having no dependents for the same calendar year, which directly supports the native Entailment label here.

inputs.name: claim_subject_is_dependent_of_another_taxpayer
inputs.question: For the current taxable year, is the individual named in the §152(b)(1) claim a dependent of another taxpayer?

skill.intent: Decide Entailment or Contradiction for a current claim that §152(b)(1) applies to an individual who may be another taxpayer's dependent.

outputs.description: Entailment when the current claim subject is another taxpayer's dependent and §152(b)(1) therefore applies; otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

source_obligations.statement: Treat an individual who is another taxpayer's dependent as having no dependents for that individual's taxable year beginning in the same calendar year.

blocks.rationale: Revise the installed airline helper without changing its supported route schedules or reader contract. The change makes the 70-pound allowance depend directly on the first two complimentary checked-bag ordinals for Business or First passengers, preventing a complimentary East Asia bag from being assessed under the 50-pound charged-bag limit while preserving the already-correct South America history case.
